event.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea Exchange Accusations Amid Rising Conflict Fears
event.canonical_title: Ethiopia and Eritrea Exchange Accusations Amid Rising Conflict Fears
event.summary: Ethiopia and Eritrea are engaged in a war of words, blaming each other for escalating tensions in the Tigray region. The situation has raised concerns about the potential for a broader regional conflict, as both nations' allies could become involved. International calls for restraint have been issued as the conflict intensifies.
